note: The actor runs two closed cycles. In each, a V3 pool sends it WETH, it sends less WETH to a V2 pool, and that V2 pool sends RAI or MET straight back to the V3 pool. The actor gains 0.012688 + 0.010240 = 0.022928 WETH before gas, and every transfer it sends or receives involves a pool it swapped on. After the 0.022782 ETH fee the actor is only about +0.000146 ETH, so the positive sign rests on a thin margin.
